item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00152","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C23","C21","C11"],"selected_candidate_label":"C23","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C23 is the strongest template because it contains distinctive language and the same administrative setting: the widest distribution of the national debt, continued Federal-employee leadership in purchasing Savings Bonds through the Payroll Savings Plan, and use of an interdepartmental committee to promote that plan. The child closely reworks these points while appointing the chairman of a newly established successor committee. C21 is also highly relevant as the earlier foundational order establishing essentially the same committee and promotional machinery, but its language is less immediately reflected in the child's letter than C23's. C11 provides a weaker parallel for a letter appointing the chairman of an interdepartmental committee.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The maintenance of stability in the economic life of the individual, the community and the Nation is well served by the widespread distribution of the national debt through the purchase of United States Savings Bonds by the people.","parent_excerpt":"The nation's economic welfare requires the widest possible distribution of the national debt through the continued sale of United States Savings Bonds to the people.","explanation":"Distinctive shared rationale concerning broad distribution of the national debt through public Savings Bond purchases."},{"child_excerpt":"Federal employees should be encouraged to maintain their leadership in the purchase of Savings Bonds through the Payroll Savings Plan","parent_excerpt":"it is important that Government employees continue their leadership in the purchase of Savings Bonds through the Pay Roll Savings Plan.","explanation":"Near-verbatim substantive language tying Federal-employee leadership to Savings Bond purchases through the payroll plan."},{"child_excerpt":"I have today issued an executive order establishing the Interdepartmental Committee for the Voluntary Payroll Savings Plan for the Purchase of United States Savings Bonds.","parent_excerpt":"The Interdepartmental Savings Bond Committee established by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of April 23, 1948, provides a vehicle for the effective promotion of the Pay Roll Savings Plan.","explanation":"Both letters situate their instructions within the same interdepartmental committee machinery for promoting payroll-plan Savings Bond purchases."}]}
